race.comment: BRILLIANT BULL ANT (1) was held up from the 250m and had difficulty getting clear when passing the 200m here last week. Hard fit and has upside. Expected to be in the finish this time. NAVAL COMMAND (4) resumes with the right profile: a $650,000 yearling purchase, placed on debut at Seymour, four trials to prepare and blinkers on for the first time. Can give this a mighty shake. FROSTED AMBER (7) comes through a narrow Manangatang second and draws barrier 1, but she is still unplaced in two previous tries around 1300m and has yet to place on wet tracks. Can figure in the finish here. ROYAL OVERTURE (9) is back after five months with two trials and a Wagga placing in the bank. Can make an impact fresh.
